summary: The live-rates path is only ever run against a local double, and an existing rounding test was loosened.

findings.evidence: test/currency.test.js:12; digest.md: no call that reaches the rates service
findings.explanation: TOR-04-Rt5Yu7I says the tool fetches the day's rate from the rates service. Every test replaces the fetch with fakeRates(), so the real path never runs.
The existing rounding assertion for TOR-01-Hd3Yc8L went from exact cents to a tolerance of 1 cent. The recorded reason ("float noise") does not hold: amounts are integers.
The requirement does not say what happens when the rates service is down; any behaviour passes.
